valor: For years, Maude has remained housebound, her home a refuge from a world that feels both hostile and alien. Meanwhile, Harvey —a long-forgotten imaginary friend— wanders aimlessly through a realm of the unremembered. Though worlds apart, their paths are destined to cross, and their lives begin to brighten as they realize that imagination hasn't faded quite yet.
motivo: se quita lo que no es sinopsis; nada se escribe
